title: Entralink run
description: How a run of the Entralink roguelike is laid out (docs/paperwhite2/design/entralink-roguelike-prototype.md): pool_rooms rooms drawn without repeats from the pool in a random order, then the final challenge. Challenges are named by their file in challenges/. tools/paperwhite2/entralink_run.py checks it and writes it into paperwhite2/entralink_run_config.h.

pool.description: The challenges the rooms before the last are drawn from

pool_rooms.description: How many rooms are drawn from the pool, at most its size (the run's order is kept in one variable, a nibble a room)

room_maps.description: The zones of the drawn rooms, taken in turn; each needs a bottom exit, where a room is entered

field_weather.description: The forest's field weather (include/system/zone_weather.h) in the rooms with no weather of their own; none if left out
